scripts.build: npm run build -w @firesafety/shared && npm run build -w @firesafety/server && npm run build -w @firesafety/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @firesafety/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @firesafety/web
